summary: Retest of the two remaining Back-navigation issues from iteration_32. Frame-accurate sampling (+16/+30/+100/+250/+500 ms) after Back on /bg?make=audi confirms BOTH bugs are FIXED via the new module-level `visits` Map hydration on mount in SearchPage.js. Browser-Back on DESKTOP (1920x1080) and MOBILE (390x844): zero .animate-pulse / car-card-skeleton nodes at every sample, 16 [data-testid=car-card] cards with IDENTICAL ids and order as before opening the car (['42155923','40839735','42120258',...]), Make dropdown reads 'Audi (3244)' from the +16ms frame (no 'Всички марки' placeholder flash), applied chip 'Марка: Audi' visible from +16ms, ZERO Hangul characters at every sample. First/direct load of /bg?make=audi in a fresh tab correctly resolves the slug and paints 'Audi (3244)' with chip and 16 cards. Changing the Model dropdown after a Back updates the URL (model=A1), reduces to 6 cards, no stale/Korean content. Pagination regression checks pass: hover on pagination-page-2 (or scroll-into-view) fires exactly one POST /api/search prefetch for page=2 on desktop; click on page-2 afterwards fires 0 additional POSTs (served from prefetch cache) and URL updates to page=2; prev / next / jump-input all navigate correctly. TWO minor findings: (A) In-app 'Назад към резултатите' back button on the car page has a ~200 ms delay before it actually pushes history — during that delay the visitor is still on the car page (which contains Korean model text and 16 related-cars); once navigation fires (~+250 ms) the results page hydrates instantly from the visits Map (skel=0, ids restored, make=Audi, hangul=0). Owner's rule is about no-wrong-content on the results page and technically this passes because the car page is still the current route during the delay, but the perceived latency should be examined. (B) On mobile, repeated scroll-to-bottom cycles (scroll top, scroll bottom again) fire additional prefetch POSTs (1 -> 5 after a second cycle), while iteration_32 spec says exactly ONE — the IntersectionObserver appears to re-observe on scroll-top / re-mount. Minor, does not affect user-visible correctness.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Назад към резултатите' button on car page has ~200ms delay between click and history navigation. During that delay the visitor is still viewing the car page. Once the pop happens, the results page renders instantly from the visits snapshot. Verified: at +16/+30/+100ms samples the DOM still contains 460 Hangul chars and 16 different card ids (the car page's related-cars section), then at +250ms flips to the correct restored results page.

Repeated scroll cycles on mobile (scroll to top, scroll to bottom again) trigger additional prefetch POSTs. Expected 1 per session, observed 5 after a second scroll-to-bottom. IntersectionObserver may not be disconnecting permanently, or re-observing on re-scroll.

action_items: Optional: investigate the ~200 ms delay between 'Назад към резултатите' click and actual history.back() to make the in-app back feel as instant as the browser Back
Optional: ensure the mobile IntersectionObserver truly fires at most once per SearchPage mount (disconnect() after first entry OR use `once: true` semantics)
critical_code_review_comments: SearchPage.js `visits` Map + `rememberVisit` correctly hydrate filters/tax/taxLabels/slugs/result on first render — no skeleton, no placeholder flash on Back. Cache-size cap of 6 is sensible for the LRU eviction.

Cache key is `window.location.search` which does NOT include the language prefix. If two languages share the same query string, the second Back will hydrate with the previous language's labels. Consider keying on `location.pathname + location.search`.
The in-app back button delay (observed ~200 ms) may be a scroll-restoration animation running before history.back(); if so, dispatch history.back() first and animate afterwards for perceived speed.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 owner acceptance criteria met (browser-Back desktop, browser-Back mobile, first-load, filter change after Back, pagination hover-prefetch, pagination click/prev/next/jump). 2 minor observations noted.

test_credentials: Not needed — all flows tested as anonymous visitor on /bg.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only interactions with Audi (3244) and Audi A1 (6) datasets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The two owner-reported bugs (skeleton flash + Make placeholder flash on browser Back) are verifiably FIXED at 1920x1080 and 390x844 against https://encar-multi-lang.preview.emergentagent.com/bg. Frame-accurate samples at +16/30/100/250/500 ms after page.go_back() from /bg/car/42155923 -> /bg?make=audi all show skeletons=0, 16 [data-testid=car-card] with matching ids, makeLabel='Audi (3244)' (never 'Всички марки'), chip 'Марка: Audi' present, hangul=0. Note: the visible clickable card is [data-testid="car-card"] (the <article>) not [data-testid="car-card-open"] (an inner div). The in-app back button has data-testid="back-to-results-button" and its click event has a ~200 ms delay before history changes — sample against the URL to know when the SPA has actually navigated, not just against the DOM. Pagination prefetch works: on desktop scrolling pagination-page-2 into view fires exactly 1 POST /api/search; hovering afterwards fires 0 more; clicking page-2 fires 0 more and URL becomes ?...&page=2. On mobile the first scroll-to-bottom fires 1 POST but subsequent scroll cycles can fire more (minor).
rca of the issue: FIXED: SearchPage.js now hydrates {filters, tax, taxLabels, slugs, result} synchronously from a module-level `visits` Map (max 6 entries, keyed on window.location.search) on the very first render after Back. Because `restored?.result` is used to seed `useState`, the initial render already carries the cars, the taxonomy value and the labels — so `loading` starts at false, `resolving` is bypassed, and no skeleton/placeholder frame is painted. A background quiet refresh after mount confirms the data. Verified with Playwright at both viewports.
